description:
Clean Your iPhone and Free Up Storage
Running out of space on your iPhone? This powerful phone cleaner helps you clean up iPhone storage, remove unnecessary files, organise your photos, videos, and contacts, and clean unwanted emails — all in one easy-to-use app.

With smart analysis and clear previews, you stay in control while freeing up space and keeping your device organized.

OPTIMIZE STORAGE – CLEAN UP IPHONE WITH CONFIDENCE
Take control of your storage and free up space quickly:
Clean up iPhone storage and remove clutter safely
Identify what’s taking up space before you delete
Review everything before cleanup — nothing is removed automatically
Free up space and keep your iPhone running smoothly.

DELETE DUPLICATE & SIMILAR PHOTOS
Clear photos without manual searching:
Detect and delete duplicate photos instantly
Find similar photos, screenshots, burst photos, and Live Photos
Smart grouping helps you choose what to keep and what to remove
Clean up your photo library and keep only the best memories.

EMAIL CLEANER – CLEAN YOUR INBOX FAST
Clear your inbox in seconds:
Find and delete spam, promos, and unread emails
Remove thousands of emails with one tap.

VIDEO CLEANUP & COMPRESSION – SAVE SPACE FAST
Videos take up the most storage. This storage cleaner helps you manage them easily:
Clean all videos or detect similar videos
Compress large videos to save space with minimal quality loss
Choose exactly which videos to compress
Free up space without deleting your important moments.

AI PHOTO ENHANCE – IMPROVE PHOTO QUALITY
Make your photos look better in one tap:
Enhance photos using AI technology
Improve clarity and details automatically
Upgrade your photos while keeping your gallery clean and organized.

CONTACTS CLEANUP – REMOVE DUPLICATES EASILY
Keep your address book neat and organized:
Detect similar and duplicate contacts
Merge or delete unwanted contacts in one tap
No more cluttered contact lists.

PRIVATE VAULT – PROTECT YOUR PERSONAL FILES
Keep your private content safe:
Hide photos and videos in a secure, PIN-protected vault
Only you can access your private files
Your privacy always comes first.

CHARGING ANIMATIONS & CLEANING GUIDE
More useful tools to enhance your experience:
Enjoy stylish charging animations while powering up
Learn safe and effective ways to clean up iPhone storage with built-in cleaning tips
Small details that make cleanup more enjoyable.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU DELETE
You’re always in control:
Preview files before deleting
Confirm every cleanup action
No accidental deletions
Clean safely and confidently.

CLEAN UP IPHONE, FREE UP SPACE, STAY ORGANIZED
This all-in-one phone cleaner helps you:
Clean up iPhone storage
Clear photos and videos
Organize contacts
Free up space and improve performance

Download now and enjoy a cleaner, more organized iPhone today.
